tasks.label: start-opencode-global-events-capture-fixed-output

tasks.label: start-opencode-global-events-capture-fixed-output-and-organize-taskdetail
args: finalized=0; finalize() { local exit_code=$?; if (( finalized )); then return; fi; finalized=1; if [[ -f tmp/opencode-global-events-debug.jsonl ]]; then bun run opencode:events:organize-taskdetail -- --input tmp/opencode-global-events-debug.jsonl || true; fi; exit $exit_code; }; trap finalize INT TERM EXIT; rm -f tmp/opencode-global-events-debug.jsonl tmp/opencode-global-events-debug.taskdetail.json; bun run opencode:events:capture -- --output tmp/opencode-global-events-debug.jsonl

tasks.label: start-web-ui
args: pids=(${(f)"$(lsof -ti tcp:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true)"}); if (( ${#pids[@]} )); then kill "${pids[@]}"; fi; fallback=(${(f)"$(lsof -ti tcp:5174 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true)"}); if (( ${#fallback[@]} )); then kill "${fallback[@]}"; fi; sleep 1; cd control-plane/web-ui && VITE_APP_PORT=${VITE_APP_PORT:-${APP_PORT:-4098}} exec bun run dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173

tasks.label: debug-session-message-500
args: cd /Users/wanglei/Downloads/phones-cloud/openerx && bun -e "const CP_URL=process.env.TEST_CP_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:4097'; const USERNAME=process.env.TEST_USERNAME||'admin'; const PASSWORD=process.env.TEST_PASSWORD||'admin123!'; const loginRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/auth/login`,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({username:USERNAME,password:PASSWORD})}); const login=await loginRes.json(); const token=login.token; const taskRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/tasks`,{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({projectId:process.env.TEST_PROJECT_ID||'proj-default',title:`debug-${Date.now()}`,prompt:'debug prompt'})}); const task=await taskRes.json(); console.log('task',taskRes.status,JSON.stringify(task)); const runtimeSessionId=`debug-session-${Date.now()}`; const sessionRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/tasks/${task.id}/sessions`,{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({runtimeSessionId,branchName:'debug-branch',sourceType:'root',isActive:true})}); console.log('session',sessionRes.status,await sessionRes.text()); const msgRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/tasks/${task.id}/sessions/messages`,{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({runtimeSessionId,message:{info:{id:`msg-${Date.now()}`,role:'assistant'},parts:[{type:'text',text:'hello'}]}})}); console.log('message',msgRes.status,await msgRes.text());"
